query: What multimodal feature sets and model architectures (visual object/person detection, audio/music/text embeddings, multimodal transformers) best extract narrative frames from films and AV clips?

response.query: What multimodal feature sets and model architectures (visual object/person detection, audio/music/text embeddings, multimodal transformers) best extract narrative frames from films and AV clips?
response.answer: Multimodal transformers combining visual object/person detection, audio/music embeddings, and text embeddings best extract narrative frames from films and AV clips. Recent advancements focus on CLIP-based architectures for effective multimodal learning.

results.content: This second ASI Sprint Report stems from the 2024–2025 Master’s elective course ‘Appification: The Cultures and Economies of Apps’, and the Cultural Data & AI Master’s Embedded Research Project ‘The Appification of AI: Exploring Emerging AI App Ecosystems and Infrastructures’, both developed, taught, and supervised by the editors in the Department of Media Studies at the University of Amsterdam, Faculty of Humanities.
